# A swimming player breathes out a bubble every 21 steps, not every bubbleTimerMax (20) (851-3717; docs/quirks.md
# section 1). The water/swim clip's scene (wiki/clips/water/swim.toml) as a replay: a custom level loaded from the
# title's load-level menu (240), a ledge over a pool three tiles deep. The player walks off the ledge and lands

# oPlayer1's step counts bubbleTimer down from 20 while it's above 0 and makes the bubble only on a step it's
